Il piatto simbolo della cucina piacentin: The signature dish of Piacenza cooking.

Pellegrino Artusi, «La scienza in cucina: Pellegrino Artusi, «La scienza in cucina e l'arte di mangiar bene» (1891), recipe 29: hot sieved potatoes, butter, parmesan, three egg yolks and nutmeg, rolled into sticks on the floured board and divided into hazelnut-sized balls, fried in oil or lard and served with boiling broth; for eight or ten people.

Metterle nella zuppiera, versarci sopra: Put them in the tureen, pour the boiling broth over them and serve at once; once fried they keep for 1 day.
Pellegrino Artusi, «La scienza in cucina: Pellegrino Artusi, «La scienza in cucina e l'arte di mangiar bene» (1891), recipe 30: rice cooked very firm in milk, with butter, parmesan, an egg yolk and nutmeg, worked like the potato bomboline; according to the author «riescono al gusto migliori di quelle di patate» (they taste better than the potato ones). Pellegrino Artusi, «La scienza in cucina: Pellegrino Artusi, «La scienza in cucina e l'arte di mangiar bene» (1891), recipe 31: a dough of flour, butter, milk, eggs and parmesan divided in two, one part coloured green with spinach, pushed into the broth with the syringe like passatelli. Pellegrino Artusi, «La scienza in cucina: Pellegrino Artusi, «La scienza in cucina e l'arte di mangiar bene» (1891), recipe 107: chard, spinach, lettuce and white cabbage cooked with a battuto of onion and aromatics, tomatoes and potato, then passed through the sieve; the sieved juice is used to cook rice or moisten a soup, with the butter and parmesan on the side, «onde non sembrino impiastri» (so that they do not look like poultices).

Pellegrino Artusi, «La scienza in cucina: Pellegrino Artusi, «La scienza in cucina e l'arte di mangiar bene» (1891), recipe 201: «un piatto appariscente, buono e di poca spesa» (a showy dish, good and inexpensive), with the filling made even with the giblets of a single hen and fat and lean prosciutto.

Pellegrino Artusi, «La scienza in cucina: Pellegrino Artusi, «La scienza in cucina e l'arte di mangiar bene» (1891), recipe 519: rounds of smooth-hound left for a few hours in salted egg and wrapped in breadcrumbs, parmesan, garlic and parsley; «un piccolo spicchio d'aglio basterà per grammi 500 di pesce» (a small clove of garlic will be enough for 500 grams of fish).

Pellegrino Artusi, «La scienza in cucina: Pellegrino Artusi, «La scienza in cucina e l'arte di mangiar bene» (1891), recipe 373: «un altro rifreddo» (another cold dish) of pounded, sieved hare, bound with béchamel and egg yolks, cooked in a bain-marie and served cold, best covered in «una veste tutta unita di gelatina» (a seamless coat of aspic).

Pellegrino Artusi, «La scienza in cucina: Pellegrino Artusi, «La scienza in cucina e l'arte di mangiar bene» (1891), recipe 94: the rabbit browned with a battuto of its liver, carnesecca and all the aromatics, finished with tomato; the sauce dresses the pappardelle and the rabbit goes to the table as the main course.

Pellegrino Artusi, «La scienza in cucina: Pellegrino Artusi, «La scienza in cucina e l'arte di mangiar bene» (1891), recipe 48: a variant of passatelli with semolina cooked in milk instead of breadcrumbs; the quantity «potrà bastare per sei o sette persone» (will be enough for six or seven people).

Pellegrino Artusi, «La scienza in cucina: Pellegrino Artusi, «La scienza in cucina e l'arte di mangiar bene» (1891), recipe 93: a teal («arzavola») cooked with the battuto, prosciutto and tomato, then boned and chopped with dried mushrooms; the sauce dresses 350 g of macaroni, strisce or denti di cavallo, for five people «se non sono gran mangiatori» (if they are not big eaters).

Pellegrino Artusi, «La scienza in cucina: Pellegrino Artusi, «La scienza in cucina e l'arte di mangiar bene» (1891), recipe 442: half-boiled potatoes in layers with truffles and parmesan, sprinkled with broth and finished with «un po' d'agro di limone» (a little lemon juice).

Pellegrino Artusi, «La scienza in cucina: Pellegrino Artusi, «La scienza in cucina e l'arte di mangiar bene» (1891), recipe 202: filled rice in the shape of little pears, formed with a small tin funnel and then coated with eggs and breadcrumbs.

Pellegrino Artusi, «La scienza in cucina: Pellegrino Artusi, «La scienza in cucina e l'arte di mangiar bene» (1891), recipe 460: it is made when boiled fish «di qualità fine» (of fine quality) is left over, bound with béchamel and browned in the country oven; it can also be served as an entremets.

Versare l'intingolo sui petti e servire: Pour the sauce over the breasts and serve at once; they do not keep.
Pellegrino Artusi, «La scienza in cucina: Pellegrino Artusi, «La scienza in cucina e l'arte di mangiar bene» (1891), recipe 269: for Artusi this is the best way of cooking chicken breasts; without truffles he suggests softened dried mushrooms.

Pellegrino Artusi, «La scienza in cucina: Pellegrino Artusi, «La scienza in cucina e l'arte di mangiar bene» (1891), recipe 326: the «petto farsito» (stuffed breast) with Bologna mortadella, which if it has come out well is cut into slices and «fa bella mostra di sè coi suoi lardelli» (shows itself off handsomely with its strips of fat).

Servire calda; si conserva in frigo 2 gi: Serve hot; it keeps in the fridge for 2 days.
Pellegrino Artusi, «La scienza in cucina: Pellegrino Artusi, «La scienza in cucina e l'arte di mangiar bene» (1891), recipe 233: polenta cooked in milk is dressed with the sauce of macaroni alla bolognese and béchamel, as an autumn and winter entremets.
Mettere a bagno i funghi secchi in acqua: Soak the dried mushrooms in lukewarm water for 20 minutes.
Legare la pollastra con lo spago perché: Tie the young hen with string so that it stays compact; clean the liver and gizzard.

Fuori dal fuoco mantecare con il resto d: Off the heat stir in the rest of the butter, the grated parmesan and the pieces of giblets.

Pellegrino Artusi, «La scienza in cucina: Pellegrino Artusi, «La scienza in cucina e l'arte di mangiar bene» (1891), recipe 260: a young hen of about 700 grams stewed with prosciutto, onion and carrot; its strained juices are used to finish the rice, which can also serve as a soup for three people.

Servire subito; si conserva in frigo 1 g: Serve at once; it keeps in the fridge for 1 day.
Pellegrino Artusi, «La scienza in cucina: Pellegrino Artusi, «La scienza in cucina e l'arte di mangiar bene» (1891), recipe 209: in Emilia young chickens are fried in lard «bianchissimo, sodo e con un odorino di alloro» (snow-white, firm and with a faint scent of bay) and finished with tomatoes, stirring until they have almost melted.

Tagliare a dadini prosciutto crudo e lin: Dice the prosciutto crudo and cured tongue and mix them into the mixture.

Togliere il filo e servirlo a fette; si: Remove the thread and serve it in slices; it keeps in the fridge for 3 days and is good cold too.
Pellegrino Artusi, «La scienza in cucina: Pellegrino Artusi, «La scienza in cucina e l'arte di mangiar bene» (1891), recipe 258: the chicken is boned whole from the inside, stuffed with pounded milk-fed veal, bread, parmesan, egg yolks, prosciutto and diced tongue, boiled for two hours in a cloth and finished with the sauce drawn from its bones.
Bagnare la mollica di pane con il latte: Moisten the breadcrumb with the hot milk and mash it into a firm paste.

Scaldare l'olio di semi in padella e fri: Heat the seed oil in a frying pan and fry them for 4-5 minutes, turning them, until golden; drain them.
In una teglia rosolare la cipolla tritat: In a baking tin brown the chopped onion in the butter for 5 minutes and put the meatballs in it.
Bagnare con la passata di pomodoro, copr: Moisten with the tomato passata, cover and cook over a low heat for 10 minutes, turning them.
Servire con un po' del loro sugo e il pa: Serve with a little of their sauce and the parmesan for serving; they keep in the fridge for 2 days.
Pellegrino Artusi, «La scienza in cucina: Pellegrino Artusi, «La scienza in cucina e l'arte di mangiar bene» (1891), recipe 334: a dish «tolto da un trattato di cucina del 1694» (taken from a cookery treatise of 1694): 350 grams of boiled tripe with prosciutto, parmesan, bone marrow and eggs, 12 or 13 meatballs fried and then finished in a tin with tomato.
Tritare insieme il prosciutto crudo e la: Chop the prosciutto crudo and onion together.
In una casseruola larga sciogliere il bu: In a wide casserole melt the butter with the chopped mixture over a medium heat, 5 minutes, until the onion colours.

Servire subito, brodoso o asciutto a pia: Serve at once, brothy or dry as you like, with one quail per plate; it does not keep.
Pellegrino Artusi, «La scienza in cucina: Pellegrino Artusi, «La scienza in cucina e l'arte di mangiar bene» (1891), recipe 44: whole quails browned in a battuto of prosciutto, onion and butter, half cooked with the broth and finished together with the rice; «quattro quaglie e grammi 400 di riso potranno bastare per quattro persone» (four quails and 400 grams of rice will be enough for four people).

Lasciarlo raffreddare del tutto, almeno: Leave it to cool completely, at least 3 hours.
Togliere lo spago, tagliarlo a fette di: Remove the string, cut it into 1 cm slices and serve it cold; it keeps in the fridge for 3 days, wrapped.
Pellegrino Artusi, «La scienza in cucina: Pellegrino Artusi, «La scienza in cucina e l'arte di mangiar bene» (1891), recipe 364: a slice of milk-fed veal stuffed in layers with chicken breast, mortadella and prosciutto, cooked for three hours with broth and served cold; it is enough for 10 or 12 people and «la gelatina di carne qui ci sta a pennello» (meat aspic suits it perfectly).
Portare a bollore una pentola d'acqua sa: Bring a pot of salted water to the boil and blanch the rice for 5 minutes.

Servirlo subito accanto al pollo o al ca: Serve it at once beside the boiled chicken or capon; it does not keep.
Pellegrino Artusi, «La scienza in cucina: Pellegrino Artusi, «La scienza in cucina e l'arte di mangiar bene» (1891), recipe 245: a rice garnish for the boiled young hen or capon, blanched in water and finished in the chicken broth; with two or three spoonfuls of sieved spinach it becomes a «riso verde» (green rice) for stracotto or small chops.

Assaggiare: se serve, aggiungere la sals: Taste: if needed, add the tomato sauce, butter and salt.
Servire subito al dente; non si conserva: Serve at once al dente; it does not keep.
Pellegrino Artusi, «La scienza in cucina: Pellegrino Artusi, «La scienza in cucina e l'arte di mangiar bene» (1891), recipe 72: a risotto made «più volte nella mia cucina» (many times in my kitchen) with tellins purged in salted water and cooked in their water; tellins can be replaced by arselle (clams) or Venetian peocci (mussels).
Tagliare a pezzi le tinche pulite, teste: Cut the cleaned tench into pieces, heads included.
Tritare aglio, prezzemolo, basilico, car: Chop the garlic, parsley, basil, carrot and white celery.

Unire il concentrato di pomodoro e poi l: Add the tomato purée and then the hot water, a little at first and the rest after 10 minutes; cook for 30 minutes, until the tench fall apart.

Piselli: rosolare la cipollina intera co: Peas: brown the whole small onion with the remaining oil and half the butter, add the peas, salt and cook them for 15 minutes with a little water; then remove the onion.
Buttare il riso nel sugo bollente e cuoc: Tip the rice into the boiling sauce and cook it for 16-18 minutes, keeping it dry.
A fine cottura unire i piselli e il burr: At the end of cooking add the peas and the remaining butter.
Servire subito con il parmigiano a parte: Serve at once with parmesan on the side for those who want it; it does not keep.
Pellegrino Artusi, «La scienza in cucina: Pellegrino Artusi, «La scienza in cucina e l'arte di mangiar bene» (1891), recipe 73: the tench browned in the battuto and passed through the sieve give the sauce for cooking the rice; it is pleasing to the taste «se avrete la prudenza di non nominare la specie del pesce usato» (if you have the prudence not to name the kind of fish used). Out of season, instead of peas, a few pieces of dried mushroom.
Piselli: tritare l'aglio, il prezzemolo: Peas: chop the garlic, parsley and pancetta and fry them in the oil for 3 minutes.
Unire i piselli sgranati, sale e pepe, b: Add the shelled peas, salt and pepper, moisten with a ladle of hot water and cook them for 15 minutes over a medium heat.
Tritare fine la cipolla e soffriggerla i: Finely chop the onion and fry it in a casserole with half the butter, 5 minutes, until reddish gold.
Versare il riso non lavato e mescolarlo: Tip in the unwashed rice and stir it for 2 minutes, until it has absorbed the soffritto.
Bagnare con l'acqua calda un mestolo all: Moisten with the hot water a ladle at a time, salt and cook for 16-18 minutes at a gentle boil.
A fine cottura unire il burro rimasto e: At the end of cooking add the remaining butter and the peas.
Togliere dal fuoco e mantecare con il pa: Take off the heat and stir in the parmesan.
Pellegrino Artusi, «La scienza in cucina: Pellegrino Artusi, «La scienza in cucina e l'arte di mangiar bene» (1891), recipe 75: risotto with a soffritto of onion in butter, cooked with hot water and finished with the peas of recipe 427 (with carnesecca) and a good fistful of parmesan; «questa dose basterà per cinque persone» (this quantity will be enough for five people). Giulia Lazzari-Turco, «Il piccolo focolare» (1921), recipe 3.20, also adds peas browned in butter to risotto.
Salsa: tritare cipolla, aglio, sedano, b: Sauce: chop the onion, garlic, celery, basil and parsley and fry them in the oil for 3 minutes.
Unire i pomodori maturi a pezzi, sale e: Add the ripe tomatoes in pieces, salt and pepper and cook for 20 minutes over a medium heat, until they have broken down.
Pass the sauce through the food mill.
In una casseruola sciogliere il burro, v: In a casserole melt the butter, tip in the rice and stir it for 2 minutes, until it has absorbed it.
Aggiungere l'acqua calda poco per volta,: Add the hot water a little at a time, salting, and cook for 8 minutes.
A metà cottura versare la salsa e finire: Halfway through cooking pour in the sauce and finish cooking for 8-10 minutes, still with the water.
Pellegrino Artusi, «La scienza in cucina: Pellegrino Artusi, «La scienza in cucina e l'arte di mangiar bene» (1891), recipe 77: a butter risotto cooked with hot water and flavoured halfway with the tomato sauce of recipe 125; carnesecca can be put in the sauce instead of oil.
Tritare cipolla, aglio, carota, sedano e: Chop the onion, garlic, carrot, celery and parsley and fry them in the oil for 5 minutes, until they colour.
Unire i gamberi, sale e pepe e girarli f: Add the crayfish, salt and pepper and turn them until they are all red, 3-4 minutes.
Aggiungere il concentrato di pomodoro e: Add the tomato purée and then the hot water; boil for 5 minutes.
Scolare i gamberi; sgusciare un quarto d: Drain the crayfish; peel a quarter of the largest, removing the black thread from the tail, and keep them aside.
Pestare gli altri nel mortaio, passarli: Pound the others in the mortar, pass them through the sieve and add the pulp to their broth.
In una casseruola sciogliere il burro e: In a casserole melt the butter and toast the unwashed rice for 2 minutes, until glossy.
Bagnarlo col brodo caldo un mestolo alla: Moisten it with the hot broth a ladle at a time and cook for 16-18 minutes.
A metà cottura unire i gamberi sgusciati: Halfway through cooking add the peeled crayfish.
Togliere dal fuoco, mantecare con il par: Take off the heat, stir in the parmesan and serve at once; it does not keep.
Pellegrino Artusi, «La scienza in cucina: Pellegrino Artusi, «La scienza in cucina e l'arte di mangiar bene» (1891), recipe 82: 300 grams of crayfish for 700 of rice and eight people; the largest whole, the others pounded and passed into the broth; the garlic serves to correct the sweetness of the crayfish. Giulia Lazzari-Turco, «Il piccolo focolare» (1921), recipe 3.23, also dresses risotto with crayfish, «buoni nei mesi dell'R» (good in the months with an R).
Togliere la crosta alle fette di pancarr: Remove the crust from the slices of sandwich bread and hollow out a 4 cm hole in the centre of each, without going through the bottom.
Friggerle nel burro per friggere a fuoco: Fry them in the butter for frying over a medium heat, 2 minutes on each side, until golden.
Disporle in una pirofila e mettere in og: Arrange them in an ovenproof dish and put a whole yolk in each hole.
Balsamella: sciogliere il burro per la b: Béchamel: melt the butter for the béchamel, add the flour and cook for 1 minute, stirring.
Versare il latte caldo a filo e cuocere: Pour in the hot milk in a thin stream and cook for 5 minutes, stirring, until it thickens.
Togliere dal fuoco, unire il parmigiano,: Take off the heat, add the parmesan, nutmeg and salt and leave it to cool slightly.
Accendere il forno a 220 °C, con il gril: Turn the oven on to 220 °C, with the grill.
